name: suggest_command
description: Offer a command for the user to run, with an explanation and confidence and risk ratings. Use plain text instead when no command is being proposed.

command.description: Shell command offered for the user to run.

confidence.description: Estimated confidence that the command fits the request.

danger.description: Risk: high for destructive or sudo commands, med for file changes, low for read-only work.

danger_notes.description: Specific risks the user should consider.
